need to determine appropriate charges.

Facts: Unit (public institution) received kickbacks (10% of book purchase) and stored in off-book petty cash for non-normal expenses. This is unit receiving bribes? The unit is a public institution (事业单位) under education bureau, fully funded. The unit received illegal benefits (回扣) from a company. That's considered "受贿" (bribery) for public officials. Since the unit is a public institution, the responsible person (director) is a public official? He is the director of a public institution, likely considered a state staff? The correction lesson says: "受贿" (not 非国家工作人员受贿) when the defendant is a state employee (including public institution staff). So label: 受贿.

Also the unit itself is a unit, so maybe "单位受贿"? The lesson didn't mention unit-specific label; they just said "受贿". So we use "受贿".

Second: Dangerous driving: He was drunk driving, causing a traffic accident. The appropriate charge is "危险驾驶". The correction lessons didn't mention that but typical Chinese criminal law: "危险驾驶罪". So label: 危险驾驶.

Thus two charges: 受贿;危险驾驶

Check if any other: maybe "单位受贿" is a separate label? In Chinese criminal law, there is "单位受贿罪". The fact says "被告单位教研中心...经手向...征订...该公司按照10%的比例向教研中心支付了410877元回扣款". So the unit received bribes. The director also responsible. So both the unit and the person may be charged. However the correction lesson says "受贿" not "非国家工作人员受贿". It doesn't mention "单位受贿". But maybe the correct label for unit is "受贿"? Usually "受贿" applies to individuals. For unit, the crime is "单位受贿罪". The label list may include that? Not given in correction lessons. The examples only show "受贿". So likely they want "受贿". But the text says both unit and person. However the answer format expects list of labels. Could be "受贿;危险驾驶". If they wanted unit, they'd maybe have separate label "单位受贿". Not in list.

Thus final answer: [罪名]受贿;危险驾驶<eoa>
